survivors_flagged.one_line: $450M Danantara/EMP preferred plus an $800M RBL to repay the $1.17B term loan, closing Q4 2026 with a sale review still open; stock down ~28% in a month, so not re-rated (check preferred dilution).

verified.catalyst: The $450M Series A 6% perpetual convertible preferred (Danantara $250M, EMP/Tunas Harapan $200M, conversion price $9.50) and the $800M Citi/Fifth Third credit line ($750M RBL plus $50M TLA) are set to close and retire the ~$1.17B term loan. Management guided closing to the end of November 2026.
verified.dated_milestone: Announced 2026-10-06. Closing guided by late November 2026 on the Q3 call (2026-11-09). Next date to watch is the 8-K confirming the close and the term-loan payoff, around 2026-11-30.
verified.bloom_gates: G1 yes: named counterparties (PT Danantara Energy International, PT Tunas Harapan Perkasa/EMP, Citibank, Fifth Third). G2 yes: committed preferred subscription and committed bank arrangers. G3 fails: there is no specific unpriced figure. The interest saving from replacing the term loan with RBL debt plus 6% preferred (roughly $40-50M a year by my estimate, about $0.30-0.40 per share, not verified against the 10-Q) has been public since 2026-10-06. It is offset by about 27% dilution if the preferred converts (47.4M new shares on ~126.5M outstanding).
verified.edge: L. (a) Run-up from the pre-catalyst base: -12%. The stock was $8.09 on 2026-10-05, ran to $11.57 on 2026-10-23, and has since given it all back, to $7.10, as crude fell (-15% on 11-02 with no company news). (b) Remaining capture from the closing itself: about 0-5%. The close is high-probability and was public 45 days ago, and it lowers leverage from ~2.1x to ~1.2x, but it does not re-rate the common. Any upside from here is mostly a crude-oil bet, which is macro. The sale review the triage cited could not be found in any source.
verified.primary_source: HighPeak Energy press release 'HighPeak Energy Announces Comprehensive Refinancing' (GlobeNewswire via financialcontent.com, 2026-10-06). HPK Q3 2026 results release and call (finviz/earningswhispers, 2026-11-09), with closing guided to late November 2026. Price history from the FMP historical-price endpoint (2026-09-21 to 2026-11-19).
verified.analysis: The refinancing is real, specific and dated, with named counterparties and committed financing, and it has not closed yet. But it is a balance-sheet repair, not a value-unlock event. The $450M convertible preferred sits ahead of the common at its full $450M liquidation value, paying 6% in cash (about $27M a year). At $7.10, well below the $9.50 conversion price, it acts as senior paper, and it caps the common's upside with about 27% dilution above $9.50. The price round-trip shows the market already priced the deal and then sold off with oil. NUMERATOR GAP: I did not pull the 10-Q, so the preferred's redemption and liquidation terms, any PIK option, change-of-control protection and the net debt after closing are unverified. The 'sale review still open' claim in the triage could not be confirmed, so the event is scored on the closing alone and on the equity's remaining upside, which is small.
